responsibility: Defines a tiny procedural macro crate used only by the coverage module’s tests to generate local `BasicCoverageBlock` bindings from numeric indices, reducing repetitive boilerplate in graph- and counter-focused test code.
same_name_distinction: This `lib.rs` is the root of a separate nested proc-macro crate used only by coverage tests, exporting the `let_bcb` macro that expands numeric inputs into `BasicCoverageBlock` local bindings. Unlike the top-level `src/lib.rs`, it does not register MIR passes or queries and exists solely as test-support macro infrastructure.
